ex: She was quite shy when she first started attending the new school.
exZh: 她刚开始上新学校时非常害羞。

ex: We spent the entire afternoon soaking up the warm sunshine in the park.
exZh: 我们整个下午都在公园里享受温暖的阳光。

ex: It is very convenient to have a grocery store right next to my apartment.
exZh: 公寓隔壁就有一家杂货店，真是太方便了。

ex: The powerful earthquake caused significant damage to the city's infrastructure and buildings.
exZh: 那场强烈的地震对城市的基建设施和建筑物造成了严重破坏。

ex: I prefer to eat a fresh green salad with my dinner every evening.
exZh: 我更喜欢每天晚餐时吃一份新鲜的蔬菜沙拉。

ex: A bowl of hot vegetable soup is perfect for a cold winter day.
exZh: 寒冷的冬日里，一碗热腾腾的蔬菜汤再好不过了。

ex: Waiting for the final exam results felt like absolute torture to the students.
exZh: 等待期末考试结果对学生们来说简直是一种折磨。

ex: Parking in a restricted area is a clear violation of the traffic regulations.
exZh: 在限制区域停车明显违反了交通规则。

ex: He realized he had left his wallet on the train after arriving home.
exZh: 到家后他才意识到自己把钱包落在火车上了。

ex: Modern technology has led to a growing addiction to social media among teenagers.
exZh: 现代科技导致青少年对社交媒体的沉溺日益严重。

ex: The hotel offers a fine dining experience with a view of the ocean.
exZh: 这家酒店提供可以欣赏海景的高级用餐体验。

ex: The plants struggled to survive in the harsh climate of the desert.
exZh: 这些植物在沙漠恶劣的气候条件下难以生存。

ex: Check the label to see if all the ingredients are natural and healthy.
exZh: 检查标签看看所有成分是否都是天然健康的。

ex: The building underwent a safety inspection before it was opened to the public.
exZh: 该建筑在对公众开放前接受了安全检查。

ex: The store manager spent the whole morning checking the current inventory levels.
exZh: 店长花了一整个上午核对当前的库存水平。

ex: Please add a little bit of salt and pepper to season the soup.
exZh: 请加一点盐和胡椒来给汤调味。

ex: After running for several miles, he was covered in sweat and exhausted.
exZh: 跑了几英里后，他浑身是汗，精疲力竭。

ex: It was a great tragedy that the historic building burned down last night.
exZh: 那座历史建筑昨晚被烧毁，真是一场巨大的悲剧。

ex: The children were very excited to see the lions at the city zoo.
exZh: 孩子们在城市动物园看到狮子时非常兴奋。

ex: The young athlete trained for years to achieve her dream of winning an Olympic gold medal.
exZh: 这位年轻运动员训练多年，只为实现她夺得奥运金牌的梦想。

ex: A short circuit in the wiring caused the lights in the entire building to go out.
exZh: 线路短路导致整栋大楼的灯都熄灭了。

ex: The government plans to invest heavily in transport infrastructure to boost the national economy.
exZh: 政府计划在交通基础设施上投入巨资，以促进国民经济发展。

ex: In many ancient legends, the dragon is depicted as a powerful creature guarding hidden treasures.
exZh: 在许多古老的传说中，龙被描绘成守护隐藏宝藏的强大生物。

ex: She spent a long time applying her makeup before heading out to the formal evening party.
exZh: 她在去参加正式晚宴前花了很长时间化妆。

ex: You need to provide a birth certificate to complete the official registration for the school.
exZh: 你需要提供出生证明才能完成学校的正式注册。

ex: The band moved from underground music to the mainstream after their latest album became a hit.
exZh: 在最新专辑大获成功后，这支乐队从地下音乐转向了主流市场。

ex: Please delete all the unnecessary files from your computer to free up some storage space.
exZh: 请删除电脑中所有不必要的文件，以腾出一些存储空间。

ex: The departure of the flight was delayed due to the heavy snowstorm at the airport.
exZh: 由于机场遭遇暴风雪，航班的起飞时间被推迟了。

ex: Goods are often damaged in transit if they are not packed with sufficient protective materials.
exZh: 如果包装保护材料不足，货物在运输过程中经常会受损。

zh: 电池、一系列、炮兵连、殴打
ex: The electric car stopped suddenly because the battery had completely run out of power.
exZh: 这辆电动汽车突然停了下来，因为电池的电量已经完全耗尽了。

ex: The committee will deem it necessary to take further action if the situation does not improve.
exZh: 如果情况没有好转，委员会将认为有必要采取进一步行动。
